title: A variadic parameter on an anonymous function compiles as a plain one.
text: `fn(int ...$xs): int => Core\Arr::count($xs)` is `E0401` at `$xs` ("expected `array<mixed>`, found `int`"): `check_anon_fn` ignores the `...` and binds `$xs` as one `int`. No error names the `...` itself, and no text says whether an anonymous function may be variadic. It closes when the `...` is either a diagnostic at the parameter or binds an array of the arguments, with a conformance case.
